subject: Remote evidence walkthrough and DPIA support - scope & access
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@healthtech.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthTech Legal <legalops@healthtech.com>, DPO, HealthTech <dpo@healthtech.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: DPIA support + remote evidence walkthrough

Camila —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our DPIA refresh for HealthTech’s new clinical analytics product we need to validate the Processing Records and technical safeguards you maintain that cover: data flows (Art. 30), subprocessors list, KMS/crypto controls, and retention enforcement.

Can Redwood provide a short, timeboxed remote walkthrough of your evidence portal and a small sample of artifacts (Art. 30 ledger, network diagram, and export controls) so our DPO can sign off? The reviewers will be internal HealthTech privacy + security (3 people).

We attached a brief excerpt of our desired ledger mapping and a suggested agenda. Key asks:
- Read-only portal access (2 hours) with a short live demo of how you present sample records
- A CSV extract of the Art. 30 ledger for sampling (we included a sample format)
- Confirmation of whether any subprocessors are subject to cross-border safeguards (SCCs, BCRs)
- Evidence of encryption in transit and at rest (KMS IDs acceptable)

Proposed windows: Jan 27 or 28 (US business hours). Please advise what you can commit to and what requires a DPA addendum or PO amendment.

Attachments:
- art30-ledger-request-format.csv (attached)
- suggested-agenda.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Privacy & Compliance Lead
HealthTech Solutions

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@healthtech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-01-16T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPIA support + remote evidence walkthrough

Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can support a remote walkthrough and provide the sample artifacts you listed, with a few clarifications/scope items so we can prepare the right exports:

1) Environment scope — do you want strictly production artifacts, or production + a sanitized staging extract? Production contains the complete ledger and KMS IDs; for privacy we can provide redacted KMS identifiers if needed.
2) Subprocessor detail — we maintain a current subprocessor inventory. I can export the list with transfer mechanism flags (SCC/BCR/SCC pending). Are you OK receiving the inventory CSV with a column for transfer safeguard?
3) Portal access — we offer timeboxed, read-only sessions via our evidence portal (SAML SSO or temporary account). We typically require a signed access agreement for guest accounts and an access-request doc completed by the requestor. I’m attaching our access-request-template for your legal team’s review.
4) Audit rights / DPA addendum — if you plan to rely on the walkthrough as formal audit evidence (e.g., to satisfy a regulator), we may need an addendum to the DPA to allow transient access to the portal and to define data handling during the session. If this is only for internal review it can be handled under the existing DPA with a confirmation email.

Next steps I propose:
- Jonas, can you confirm which artifacts we can export as CSV/CSV excerpts and whether we can provide redacted KMS identifiers?
- Marissa, can your team own the scheduling + produce the network-architecture.pdf and the Art. 30 ledger excerpt?

Proposed times work for us (Jan 27 or 28). I’ll loop Legal if an addendum is requested.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Manager, Privacy Programs
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@healthtech.com>, HealthTech Legal <legalops@healthtech.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: DPIA support + remote evidence walkthrough

Folks — quick operational update on deliverables we can commit to and access model: 

Deliverables (pre-work; we will upload to the portal ahead of the session):
- art30-ledger-excerpt.csv (sample of processing activities with purposes, categories, data locations)
- network-architecture.pdf (high-level diagram with zones and boundary controls)
- export-controls-summary.docx (high level; we will not export raw logs but will provide KMS key IDs and a redacted log snippet)

Access model:
- We will grant time-limited, read-only portal access for up to 2 hours. Accounts are provisioned via SAML or temporary guest accounts; guest accounts require a signed access agreement (simple template attached: access-request-template.docx).
- For KMS and crypto evidence we can provide KMS key identifiers and a screenshot of key policies; we cannot share raw KMS key material.
- If HealthTech requires an on-site or deeper forensic export, that likely needs a DPA addendum and a PO for professional services.

Scheduling: Jan 27, 10:00–12:00 PT (90–120 minutes) works for our infra and privacy SMEs. Please confirm attendees and whether you want production or a sanitized staging view.

Related links:
- Evidence portal (preview): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/HealthTech-DPIA-portal
- DPA addendum template: https://app.docusign.com/HT/DPA-addendum/123456789

Attachments: art30-ledger-excerpt.csv; network-architecture.pdf; access-request-template.docx

Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: DPIA support + remote evidence walkthrough

Camila/Marissa —

Thanks — that’s helpful. We can confirm the following: 

- Attendees (HealthTech): Priya Singh (Privacy), Miguel Ortiz (Security), Lila Chen (DPO advisor) — 3 people total.
- We prefer production artifacts but redacted KMS identifiers are fine.
- We will sign the guest access agreement and can complete the access-request-template; please send the template as a Word doc and we’ll return it.
- Regarding the DPA addendum: HealthTech Legal will review the template (we may need a clause clarifying that the walkthrough does not constitute an audit right beyond the explicit session). If an addendum is needed we’ll route it through DocuSign.

Jan 27, 10:00–12:00 PT works for us. Please send the portal access instructions and the DocuSign link for the access agreement/addendum when available.

Priya Singh
Privacy & Compliance Lead
HealthTech Solutions
